AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Represents a user with administrative privileges. The existence of a document in the /admins/{uid} collection grants access to the management console.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the administrator.

email.description: The email address associated with the admin account.

LocalizedString.title: LocalizedString
LocalizedString.description: Represents a piece of text content available in multiple languages, primarily English and Chinese, to support the app's multilingual features.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LocalizedString entity.

en.description: The English translation of the text.

zh.description: The Chinese (Simplified) translation of the text.

HomepageSectionContent.title: HomepageSectionContent
HomepageSectionContent.description: Defines the content and configuration for dynamic sections on the homepage, such as the Hero section.

id.description: Unique identifier for the homepage section content (e.g., 'hero', 'about-us').

sectionType.description: Identifies the type or purpose of the homepage section (e.g., 'hero', 'call-to-action').

headlineTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the main headline of the section. (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N HomepageSectionContent)

subtitleTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the subtitle or secondary text of the section. (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N HomepageSectionContent)

imageUrl.description: URL to a primary image associated with the section (e.g., the 45-degree perspective 3D product image for the hero section).

ProductCategory.title: ProductCategory
ProductCategory.description: Categorizes different product types offered by Heovose, such as AIO, Mini PC, Monitors, and KIOSK.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProductCategory entity.

nameTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the name of the product category (e.g., 'All-in-One PCs'). (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N ProductCategory)

slug.description: A URL-friendly identifier for the product category, used for routing or display.

thumbnailImageUrl.description: URL to a thumbnail image representing the product category.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents an individual product within Heovose's offerings, belonging to a specific product category.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

nameTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the product's name. (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N Product)

descriptionTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for a brief description of the product. (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N Product)

mainImageUrl.description: URL to the product's primary marketing image.

productCategoryId.description: Reference to ProductCategory to which this product belongs. (Relationship: ProductCategory 1:N Product)

galleryImageUrls.description: An array of URLs to additional images for the product gallery.

Statistic.title: Statistic
Statistic.description: Holds key company statistics, such as factory counts or product series numbers, for engaging visualization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Statistic entity.

value.description: The numerical or text value of the statistic (e.g., '3', '30+').

unitTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the unit or label of the statistic (e.g., 'Global Factories', 'AIO Series'). (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N Statistic)

descriptionTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for a more detailed descriptive text of the statistic. (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N Statistic)

order.description: The intended display order of the statistic on the page.

ProductionStep.title: ProductionStep
ProductionStep.description: Details each step of Heovose's 11-step production process, from IQC to OQA.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProductionStep entity.

stepNumber.description: The sequential number of the production step (e.g., 1, 2, ..., 11).

titleTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the title or abbreviation of the production step (e.g., 'IQC'). (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N ProductionStep)

descriptionTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for a detailed explanation of the production step. (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N ProductionStep)

iconUrl.description: URL to an icon or graphic representing the production step.

FactoryLocation.title: FactoryLocation
FactoryLocation.description: Specifies the geographical details of Heovose's global factory locations for display on an interactive map.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FactoryLocation entity.

nameTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the name of the factory location (e.g., 'China Factory'). (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N FactoryLocation)

countryTextId.description: Reference to LocalizedString for the country where the factory is located (e.g., 'China'). (Relationship: LocalizedString 1:N FactoryLocation)

latitude.description: The geographical latitude coordinate of the factory location.

longitude.description: The geographical longitude coordinate of the factory location.

mapMarkerImageUrl.description: URL to an image or icon to use as a marker on the map for this location.

definition.description: Stores a list of authenticated administrators. Only UIDs present here can access the /admin console.
Stores localized text content for English and Chinese, referenced by other entities for multilingual support. Publicly readable.
Defines dynamic sections for the homepage, such as the Hero section. Includes references to localized strings for text content. Publicly readable.
Categorizes different product types offered by Heovose. Includes reference to localized string for category names. Publicly readable.
Represents an individual product, referencing localized strings for name and description, and a product category. Publicly readable.
Holds key company statistics for engaging visualization. Includes references to localized strings for units and descriptions. Publicly readable.
Details each step of Heovose's production process. Includes references to localized strings for titles and descriptions. Publicly readable.
Specifies the geographical details of Heovose's global factory locations for display on an interactive map. Includes references to localized strings. Publicly readable.

firestore.reasoning: The structure includes a critical /admins/{uid} collection to handle authorization for the management console, separating authenticated users from authorized managers.
